msg: Bonjour ! Nous sommes deux et nous voulons faire de la plongée pour la première fois. C'est combien ? Et j'ai souvent le mal de mer, c'est un problème ?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Your first dive in the Rosario Islands can be a wonderful experience. For beginners, we recommend the Dive Mini Course: it includes pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor, and no certification is needed.

The online price includes the 10% website discount.

The boat ride from Cartagena takes about an hour. If you often get seasick, have a light breakfast beforehand and consider seasickness tablets; if you take medication, ask your doctor whether it’s compatible with diving.

Which departure applies to you: Cartagena or the islands? I can share the matching booking link.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊
